BusinessName.BusinessNameLine1Txt: NATIONAL ORGANIZATION FOR ARTS IN HEALTH

IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: To unite advance and serve the field of arts in health. NOAH is a catalyst for the collective voices of arts in health; coordinating advocating and amplifying the impact of the arts on health and wellbeing.
IRS990.MissionDesc: To unite advance and serve the field of arts in health by building a community to amplify educate and advocate for the power of the arts to improve health and well being for everyone.
IRS990.Desc: NOAHCON the annual NOAH conference held each fall attracts artists of all disciplines; arts administrators researchers creative and expressive art therapists educators students;anyone with an interest in this ever growing field.This conference informs participants on current and emerging topics in the arts in health field connecting an ever-expanding community with inspiring conversations collaboration and innovation. Keynote speakers who excel in different areas of healing arts deliver messages of inspiration and cultural diversity within their own communities with several musical performances as well. Networking and several plenary sessions are offered.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: Core Curriculum Professionalization As part of the ongoing Professionalization program The NOAH Essentials of Arts in Health Certificate of Completion was launched last year and continues on.The certificate designates an individual as having successfully completed a rigorous online test on the Core Curriculum for Arts in Health Professionals so they may then pursue either employment in the field or use this as additional useful knowledge in their current positions in the arts in healthcare field.
